setup_sentence_ranking_task: set up a sentence ranking task by loading the dictionary and initializing the SentenceRankingTask class
load_sentence_ranking_dataset: load a train, valid, or test dataset split for sentence ranking with optional shuffling and truncation
build_sentence_ranking_model: build a model for sentence ranking that registers a classification head with one output class
add_sentence_ranking_args: add task-specific CLI arguments like num-classes, init-token, separator-token, and shorten-method to the parser
load_sentence_ranking_dictionary: load a token dictionary from a file path and add a mask symbol to it
